gripOrHq.title: Corporate War
gripOrHq.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Minotaur
gripOrHq.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

gripOrHq.title: Edgerunner, Inc., Temps
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain three consecutive actions, which you may use only to install cards. You are not required to take all three of these actions.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Downsizing
gripOrHq.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
heapOrArchives.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

heapOrArchives.title: Olivia Salazar
heapOrArchives.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Top Runners' Conference
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.

ice.title: Coyote
ice.rulesText: *For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength, unless Runner pays [2] while passing Coyote. Gain [3] when you rez Coyote.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

ice.title: Snowbank
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Washed-Up Solo Construct
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Washed-Up Solo Construct.
